gen-dafont-woodgod-gf-noto-sans-bengali: Commanding Woodgod lifts its lowercase almost up to capital height. Noto Sans Bengali echoes that, its capitals barely above lowercase, and its distinctly open mouths add a contemporary ease.
gen-dafont-woodgod-gf-noto-sans-buginese: A wide channel runs into every bowl of Woodgod. Woodgod excels at vintage, commanding display, while Noto Sans Buginese counters with open letter mouths and short ascenders, a modern sans.
gen-dafont-woodgod-gf-noto-sans-buhid: Noto Sans Buhid, a sans-serif with generous space between curve ends and stems, lends a modern, open tone. And Woodgod brings its vintage, commanding display character over that quiet footing.
gen-dafont-woodgod-gf-noto-sans-carian: Commanding describes Woodgod, vintage down to its wide bowl channels. Woodgod does vintage display best, while Noto Sans Carian keeps things clean with terminals held apart like open scissor blades.
gen-dafont-woodgod-gf-noto-sans-chakma: Commanding and vintage, Woodgod lifts its lowercase nearly to capital height, much as Noto Sans Chakma does. Its open, uncrowded mouths give the loud heading plenty of room to breathe.
gen-dafont-woodgod-gf-noto-sans-coptic: Loud, vintage, and tall in the lowercase: that is Woodgod. Woodgod's talent is commanding display, while Noto Sans Coptic, a sans-serif, brings clean, contemporary lines ruled by their middle zone.
gen-dafont-woodgod-gf-noto-sans-cuneifor: A wide channel into every bowl gives Woodgod its commanding, vintage look. And where Woodgod is built to command, Noto Sans Cuneiform, a sans-serif, is built to open up, its lowercase swollen like glass beads.
gen-dafont-woodgod-gf-noto-sans-ethiopic: Woodgod brings a commanding, vintage voice, with a wide channel into every bowl. But Noto Sans Ethiopic stands sturdy and tall, its c terminals hanging far from the bowl.
gen-dafont-woodgod-gf-noto-sans-georgian: Loud and vintage, Woodgod carries a wide channel into every bowl, while Noto Sans Georgian stays open throughout. Paragraphs of the sans-serif would flow smoothly, with its curves left open.
gen-dafont-woodgod-gf-noto-sans-grantha: Old-fashioned and loud: Woodgod wears a wide channel into every bowl. Noto Sans Grantha takes over with tall little letters like flattened pen-nib bowls, so reading never snags on a closed-up bowl.
